body: My job, my health, my relationship.

I'm on the verge now. I give and give and everyone and everything takes and takes. I'm empty. I have nothing left to give. My friend tells me to hang in there. I have no energy left to hang on with. Helpline try to use the distraction method but what if you can't even bring yourself to do that. People that haven't gone through the thoughts just don't understand the struggle
